title: Task list API: pagination and a reported date bug
summary: An existing task-list API (see README.md and src/) needs page-by-page listing, and a bug reported by a user must be fixed.
users: Front-end developers calling the API; end users who see the task list.
nonGoals: Sorting options other than by id
interface:
The existing code in src/ and the API described in README.md. Keep `createServer()` exported from `src/server.ts`. Node.js 24 built-ins only; erasable TypeScript only.

**Bug report #14 (from a user):** "Tasks due on the 'due before' date are missing from the list. For example, a task due 2026-03-31 does not appear for `due_before=2026-03-31`. I think `parseISODate` in `src/dates.ts` gets the timezone wrong."

New response shape for `GET /tasks` (with or without `due_before`): `{ "items": Task[], "page": number, "per_page": number, "total": number }`, where `total` counts all matching tasks before paging.

stories.title: Page through tasks
stories.iWant: to fetch tasks one page at a time
stories.gherkin:
Scenario: second page
  Given 45 tasks exist
  When I GET /tasks?page=2&per_page=20
  Then items are tasks 21 to 40 in id order
  And total is 45, page is 2 and per_page is 20

Scenario: defaults
  When I GET /tasks
  Then page is 1 and per_page is 20

Scenario: invalid paging
  When I GET /tasks?per_page=101
  Then the response is 400 with error code invalid_pagination

stories.title: Due-before includes the date itself
stories.iWant: tasks due on the chosen date to be included
stories.gherkin:
Scenario: boundary
  Given a task due 2026-03-31
  When I GET /tasks?due_before=2026-03-31
  Then the task is in items

frs.title: Pagination
frs.text: When GET /tasks is requested, the system shall return { items, page, per_page, total } with items ordered by id ascending, page defaulting to 1 and per_page defaulting to 20. A page past the end returns an empty items list with the correct total.

frs.title: Pagination validation
frs.text: If page is not an integer of at least 1, or per_page is not an integer from 1 to 100, the system shall respond 400 invalid_pagination.

frs.title: Inclusive due-before
frs.text: When due_before=D is given, the system shall include tasks due on or before D and exclude tasks without a due date; pagination and total apply after this filter.

frs.title: Existing behavior kept
frs.text: The system shall keep the existing POST /tasks behavior and error codes (invalid_body, invalid_title, invalid_date) and respond 400 invalid_date for an invalid due_before.

nfrs.title: Type safety
nfrs.text: The code shall pass tsc --noEmit in strict mode.

modules.name: server
modules.text: Routing and responses. Serves FR-001 to FR-004.
